title: TokenRequestLoginTx
description: Exchange a Passkey sign-in handle (loginTx) for tokens.

loginTx.description: Short-lived, single-use handle from /auth/passkeys/assert/verify (or from /auth/passkeys/attest/verify when issueLoginTx=true).

orgId.description: Optional org context when the handle isn't already bound and the user has multiple memberships.
